nodes.text: A little while back, three Centerscore guys were sentenced to do a ride-along with the cantankerous Officer Monte...
When it was done, he appointed them 'Junior Detectives'... But did any ever actually come back?
Find out now!
It's New Year's Eve at the Centerscore Police Station.
The building is quiet and still...
Except for one very excited police officer and the Junior Detective trailing behind him!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ah, New Year's Eve! A night of merriment, joy, and frivolity...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And my absolute favorite night of the year! Ask me why, Junior Detective!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why, Junior Detective?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're not the sharpest pebble in the drawer, are you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I once stuck a pebble up my nose...?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ahem! New Year's Eve is my favorite night of the year because it's the night when this good town is lit up by dozens of rowdy, noisy, rambunctious parties...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that means there are dozens of parties for us to break up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're telling me! I left one heck of a hootenanny to come here! We were playing `Ogres and Elves,` but then we were pretending to be popular, and then, well, it all got kind of confusing...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're telling me! I left one heck of a hootenanny to come here! We were playing [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves,[/i][/color] but then we were pretending to be popular, and then, well, it all got kind of confusing...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I must say, I appreciate your dedication to the job, Shortstop. Most of my Junior Detectives never bother to show their lollygagging faces around here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course! It's my duty to protect and swerve!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's protect and `serve.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's protect and [color=#e23b3b][i]serve.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You mean I've been doing all that swerving for nothing?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I suppose a good swerve never hurt a man. You ready to go bust some parties?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure! Whatever you say, `Jefe!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure! Whatever you say, [color=#e23b3b][i]Jefe![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's Spanish for Chief!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Sure it is, Pipsqueak. Sure it is.
A few minutes later, Officer Monte and Erik drive through town...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So these parties we're busting... What exactly are we busting them for?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are they crime parties? My dad once threw a mystery theater dinner party, and things got pretty suspicious...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't you worry. Once we bust down some doors, I'm sure we'll find all kinds of seedy, criminal activity...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But for now, we're just going to drive around town until we hear the most terrible sound in the universe...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The growl of a grizzly bear with a shark on its back?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No... `People having fun.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... [color=#e23b3b][i]People having fun.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: In fact... I think I hear some right now!
Officer Monte makes a hard left and pulls into a parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There must be some mistake... According to my Star Tour map, we're at... Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There can't be a party happening here! It's winter break!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Detective Lesson number 1: You can trust your brain... Or you can trust your senses.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Turn off that twisted mess of neurons you call a brain, boy... And tell me what you hear!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hear... I hear...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Music! And laughter! And joy!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Exactly! Now let's go ruin it!
Meanwhile, in a classroom in Centerscore High...
The Annual Faculty Christmas Party is in full swing!
At one end of the room, Ms. Prez talks with Ms. Pliny...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: My word! So Denni kissed Colt, which is why he broke up with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: But then when she started dating Ben, he ended up kissing Jessica, and they broke up too!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Scandalous!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And get this... According to Mr. Russell, Jessica actually orchestrated the whole thing!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: I never did like her!
And on the other side of the room, Coach Kessler talks to Coach Sanderson...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm telling you, buddy, your  boys might have some moves, but the Centerscore swim team is far and away the school's top athletes!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: In your dreams, pal! The football team rules, and you know it!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'd like to see your boys in the water!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Yeah, well I'd like to see your girls on the field!
Just then, the door to the room flies open! Officer Monte and Erik burst in!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hands in the air!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Feet on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Aw no, not `this` again!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw no, not [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] again!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Is that Erik Ericson?
Principal Shapiro stomps towards the two...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: What on Earth is the meaning of this?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me, Shapiro? Because I'm seeing violations of local noise ordinances, unlicensed use of public buildings for recreational purposes...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Not to mention what appears to be unauthorized usage of a type-3 Classified chemical!
Across the room, Mr. Russell freezes, a vial in his hand...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: It's just dye... It... It makes the punch green...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Green punch... Sounds pretty fishy!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ain't that the truth? I'm going to have to break this little shindig up! All of you need to get on your way, now!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Talk about a buzz-kill...
Principal Shapiro leans in close to Monte and talks in a low, soft voice...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Monte, please... You don't have to do this...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: It's New Year's Eve... Why don't you just go and have some fun?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fun? Fun is for other men, Kathy. Weaker... Lesser men.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't let me catch you here again.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I have to come back here, I'm the Principal!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: ...You know what I meant.
Monte and Erik turn and walk out.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: I'm not kidding, was that Erik Ericson? Am I the only one that saw that?
And right outside, Erik and Monte head back to his car...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Say, how'd you know Principal Shapiro's first name anyway?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: ...It's a long story.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Kathy, huh? I always figured it would be something exciting, like Guinevere...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're one odd duck, kid.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now lace up your crime-fighting shoes... Because we've got some parties' butts to kick!
And so, a little while later, Monte and Erik sit crouched in the bushes outside a popular kids' party, staking out the festivities...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So $ZOE still has feelings for Matteo? I had no idea!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A love triangle under my very roof! It's giving me goose pimples!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Keep your skin conditions to yourself, kid. We need to wait for the exact right minute to strike...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Strike? I thought we were just watching people have fun!
Just then, fireworks explode in the night sky! Everyone yells and cheers!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look at me! Woo! I'm dancing on a picnic table!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that's our cue! Move!
Monte and Erik burst out of the bushes!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Everybody freeze!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahh! It's the police!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw come on, really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This can't be happening!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Afraid it is, Captain Tweed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do people keep saying that? I don't even `wear` tweed!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do people keep saying that? I don't even [color=#e23b3b][i]wear[/i][/color] tweed!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh no. No no no. You are `not` busting my party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. No no no. You are [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] busting my party!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No? What are you gonna do about it, missy?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This!
Jessica pulls open her purse and whips out a huge stack of papers!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Permit to use a public park for recreation... Here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Permit to host an unsupervised group of more than 50 minors... Here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And finally, a signed declaration by everyone within 10 miles of here that they won't file any noise complaints! Read it and weep, Officer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, you are on top of this!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've had a lot of parties get busted.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Lemme see that!
Monte grabs the paperwork and rifles through it...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Grumble grumble... This all looks in order...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess we can just get going, right, and leave everyone alone...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Except!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Except...?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Except I don't see any permit here for the presence of an unleashed Central American amphibian!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?!
Jessica spins around and sees Ryan holding up Lyle!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Everybody! Look at Lyle! You can tell he's mad because he keeps biting at things!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica storms over to Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?! Why would you bring Lyle here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why wouldn't I? Everyone loves Lyle!
As soon as Ryan says that, Lyle snaps at him, biting the side of his head!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ow! Ow ow ow!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You have got to be kidding me...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Them's the breaks, little lady.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Game. Set. `Checkmate.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Game. Set. [color=#e23b3b][i]Checkmate.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So not fair!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Attention! Everyone has ten minutes to vacate the premises, go home, and sit in melancholy silence, contemplating the futility of your lives!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aw... I hate doing that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're the worst, Officer Monte!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just doing my job!
Erik and Monte walk away from the park as the students turn and scatter...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Mmmm... Smell that? That's the smell of a bunch of quiet, unhappy people on New Year's Eve!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah... About that...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Got something to say, Shortstop?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... Not to question my Superior Officer... But what we're doing here doesn't really seem right...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean, I'm all about Protecting and Serving, but none of these parties are really bothering anyone...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe we should just let them be.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now listen here, little man, because I'm only going to say this once.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Parties might seem like good times where no one gets hurt. They might `seem` like totally harmless get-togethers where everyone's laughing and having fun...
nodes.text_bbcode: Parties might seem like good times where no one gets hurt. They might [color=#e23b3b][i]seem[/i][/color] like totally harmless get-togethers where everyone's laughing and having fun...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But they're not! Every party `always` goes wrong! And someone gets laughed at! And someone gets teased! And someone gets called a little shrimp with a weirdo mustache!
nodes.text_bbcode: But they're not! Every party [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] goes wrong! And someone gets laughed at! And someone gets teased! And someone gets called a little shrimp with a weirdo mustache!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did... Did something happen to you at a party?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No! Shut up! Now let's go put the shin in shindig!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay...
And so Monte and Erik go around town...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I've seen a lot of New Year's debauchery, but I'm not sure I've ever seen anything so sick and depraved...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We're just sitting around watching movies and eating popcorn!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yeah? What do you call this weapon of mass destruction?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's a welding torch!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's evidence now, punk! Now get out!
And after that, in the MAN frat...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Show's over, folks! Time to get back to the disgusting dens of trash you call homes!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Dude, are you gonna bust every party we throw?!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: This is the worst college ever!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You'll thank me when you're older, son. Now get moving!
And soon enough, they approach a familiar house...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Last house on my list. This one was a real squeaker... Barely registered on the decibel scale...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But no one gets by Officer Monte Carlos Monte!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey... Wait a minute... I know where we are...
But before Erik can stop him, Monte kicks open the door...
And storms into Brendan's den!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Nobody move! This party is officially busted!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! Please don't arrest me, sir!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This can't be happening! I've already got priors!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...What do you have priors for?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sophomore year was rough times, man.
Suddenly, Ashley stands up and points...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: `Erik?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Erik?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Hi guys.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you doing with him? Did you lead him here?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, I didn't lead him here, I swear! I think he has super-hearing!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: More like a super sense of justice. Parties over, Pointdexters. Get on home.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, sir, I really don't think you need to break this party up. We're not doing anything wrong...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh yeah? There's noise level for one...
Monte turns to the side of the room where the table is set up for `Ogres and Elves.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Monte turns to the side of the room where the table is set up for [b]Ogres and Elves.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Over here, we've clearly got some kind of devil-summoning ritual...
He turns to the far side of the room, where Taylor is covering her face in embarrassment...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And I can't even begin to fathom why you'd have a pretty cheerleader-type here short of some sort of elaborate kidnapping scenario...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just a tip, kids... You'll never get the ransom. Her parents don't love her nearly enough.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now, if you could all just be on your way...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I said no. This isn't right. These are my friends, and they're just having fun.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I agreed to be a Junior Detective because I thought it was the right thing to do... Because I believed in truth and justice...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But if this is justice... Then I quit!
Erik rips the badge off his chest and hurls it at Monte. Slowly, Monte kneels down and picks it off the floor.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: ...This is a Space 'Splosions Convention Attendee Badge.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes it is. Yes. It. `Is.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes it is. Yes. It. [color=#e23b3b][i]Is.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Whoa... Was Erik just... Kind of awesome?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I know!
Officer Monte sighs deeply...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Look, son, I appreciate that it's not always easy to do the right thing... But the law's the law!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then why are you the only officer working tonight?! I thought maybe you were just dedicated, and then I thought maybe you were the only officer in the world...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But now I think you might just be crazy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So here's what's gonna happen, `Jefe`. My friends and I are going over to this table where we're gonna sit down and play `Ogres and Elves.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So here's what's gonna happen, [color=#e23b3b][i]Jefe[/i][/color]. My friends and I are going over to this table where we're gonna sit down and play [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You can either forcefully drag us out of here and make a huge scene...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or you can sit down and join us!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: J... Join you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure, why not? It doesn't seem like you're doing anything else!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, it'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We're doing the Dragons with Flagons expansion! It's, uh... It's gonna get pretty real.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's just, I... I don't really want to get made fun of...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No one's gonna make fun of you!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, we're nerds! We're the guys who `get` made fun of!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we're nerds! We're the guys who [color=#e23b3b][i]get[/i][/color] made fun of!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tell me about it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You in... Sir?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Okay! But just for a little while!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yay! This is weird, but yay!
Everyone settles down at the table. Monte awkwardly takes a seat...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So, the first thing you need to do is create a character...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I will be Osmund Bricklebeard, Vanguard of the Hyberian Wastes, Harbinger of the Seventh Apocalypse, and Wielder of the Obsidian Moustache of Oblivion!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Whoa! Have you played this before?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Not at all. I'm just very, `very` manly.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not at all. I'm just very, [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] manly.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now let's kill some dragons and take their flagons!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!
Wow! Looks like Erik managed to bring a little holiday cheer to Officer Monte! Who would've thought?
We hope you enjoyed this `exclusive` piece of promotional content! Keep drinking Dr. Pepper, and see the other special stories!
nodes.text_bbcode: We hope you enjoyed this [b]exclusive[/b] piece of promotional content! Keep drinking Dr. Pepper, and see the other special stories!

nodes.text: A little while back, three Centerscore guys were sentenced to do a ride-along with the cantankerous Officer Monte...
When it was done, he appointed them 'Junior Detectives'... But did any ever actually come back?
Find out now!
It's New Year's Eve at the Centerscore Police Station.
The building is quiet and still...
Except for one very excited police officer and the Junior Detective trailing behind him!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ah, New Year's Eve! A night of merriment, joy, and frivolity...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And my absolute favorite night of the year! Ask me why, Junior Detective!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why, Junior Detective?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're not the sharpest pebble in the drawer, are you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I once stuck a pebble up my nose...?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ahem! New Year's Eve is my favorite night of the year because it's the night when this good town is lit up by dozens of rowdy, noisy, rambunctious parties...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that means there are dozens of parties for us to break up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're telling me! I left one heck of a hootenanny to come here! We were playing `Ogres and Elves,` but then we were pretending to be popular, and then, well, it all got kind of confusing...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're telling me! I left one heck of a hootenanny to come here! We were playing [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves,[/i][/color] but then we were pretending to be popular, and then, well, it all got kind of confusing...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I must say, I appreciate your dedication to the job, Shortstop. Most of my Junior Detectives never bother to show their lollygagging faces around here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course! It's my duty to protect and swerve!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's protect and `serve.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's protect and [color=#e23b3b][i]serve.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You mean I've been doing all that swerving for nothing?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I suppose a good swerve never hurt a man. You ready to go bust some parties?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure! Whatever you say, `Jefe!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure! Whatever you say, [color=#e23b3b][i]Jefe![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's Spanish for Chief!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Sure it is, Pipsqueak. Sure it is.
A few minutes later, Officer Monte and Erik drive through town...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So these parties we're busting... What exactly are we busting them for?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are they crime parties? My dad once threw a mystery theater dinner party, and things got pretty suspicious...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't you worry. Once we bust down some doors, I'm sure we'll find all kinds of seedy, criminal activity...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But for now, we're just going to drive around town until we hear the most terrible sound in the universe...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The growl of a grizzly bear with a shark on its back?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No... `People having fun.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... [color=#e23b3b][i]People having fun.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: In fact... I think I hear some right now!
Officer Monte makes a hard left and pulls into a parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There must be some mistake... According to my Star Tour map, we're at... Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There can't be a party happening here! It's winter break!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Detective Lesson number 1: You can trust your brain... Or you can trust your senses.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Turn off that twisted mess of neurons you call a brain, boy... And tell me what you hear!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hear... I hear...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Music! And laughter! And joy!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Exactly! Now let's go ruin it!
Meanwhile, in a classroom in Centerscore High...
The Annual Faculty Christmas Party is in full swing!
At one end of the room, Ms. Prez talks with Ms. Pliny...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: My word! So Denni kissed Colt, which is why he broke up with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: But then when she started dating Ben, he ended up kissing Jessica, and they broke up too!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Scandalous!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And get this... According to Mr. Russell, Jessica actually orchestrated the whole thing!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: I never did like her!
And on the other side of the room, Coach Kessler talks to Coach Sanderson...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm telling you, buddy, your  boys might have some moves, but the Centerscore swim team is far and away the school's top athletes!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: In your dreams, pal! The football team rules, and you know it!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'd like to see your boys in the water!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Yeah, well I'd like to see your girls on the field!
Just then, the door to the room flies open! Officer Monte and Erik burst in!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hands in the air!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Feet on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Aw no, not `this` again!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw no, not [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] again!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Is that Erik Ericson?
Principal Shapiro stomps towards the two...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: What on Earth is the meaning of this?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me, Shapiro? Because I'm seeing violations of local noise ordinances, unlicensed use of public buildings for recreational purposes...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Not to mention what appears to be unauthorized usage of a type-3 Classified chemical!
Across the room, Mr. Russell freezes, a vial in his hand...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: It's just dye... It... It makes the punch green...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Green punch... Sounds pretty fishy!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ain't that the truth? I'm going to have to break this little shindig up! All of you need to get on your way, now!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Talk about a buzz-kill...
Principal Shapiro leans in close to Monte and talks in a low, soft voice...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Monte, please... You don't have to do this...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: It's New Year's Eve... Why don't you just go and have some fun?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fun? Fun is for other men, Kathy. Weaker... Lesser men.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't let me catch you here again.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I have to come back here, I'm the Principal!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: ...You know what I meant.
Monte and Erik turn and walk out.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: I'm not kidding, was that Erik Ericson? Am I the only one that saw that?
And right outside, Erik and Monte head back to his car...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Say, how'd you know Principal Shapiro's first name anyway?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: ...It's a long story.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Kathy, huh? I always figured it would be something exciting, like Guinevere...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're one odd duck, kid.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now lace up your crime-fighting shoes... Because we've got some parties' butts to kick!
And so, a little while later, Monte and Erik sit crouched in the bushes outside a popular kids' party, staking out the festivities...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So $ZOE still has feelings for Matteo? I had no idea!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A love triangle under my very roof! It's giving me goose pimples!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Keep your skin conditions to yourself, kid. We need to wait for the exact right minute to strike...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Strike? I thought we were just watching people have fun!
Just then, fireworks explode in the night sky! Everyone yells and cheers!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look at me! Woo! I'm dancing on a picnic table!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that's our cue! Move!
Monte and Erik burst out of the bushes!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Everybody freeze!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahh! It's the police!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw come on, really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This can't be happening!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Afraid it is, Captain Tweed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do people keep saying that? I don't even `wear` tweed!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do people keep saying that? I don't even [color=#e23b3b][i]wear[/i][/color] tweed!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh no. No no no. You are `not` busting my party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. No no no. You are [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] busting my party!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No? What are you gonna do about it, missy?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This!
Jessica pulls open her purse and whips out a huge stack of papers!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Permit to use a public park for recreation... Here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Permit to host an unsupervised group of more than 50 minors... Here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And finally, a signed declaration by everyone within 10 miles of here that they won't file any noise complaints! Read it and weep, Officer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, you are on top of this!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've had a lot of parties get busted.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Lemme see that!
Monte grabs the paperwork and rifles through it...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Grumble grumble... This all looks in order...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess we can just get going, right, and leave everyone alone...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Except!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Except...?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Except I don't see any permit here for the presence of an unleashed Central American amphibian!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?!
Jessica spins around and sees Ryan holding up Lyle!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Everybody! Look at Lyle! You can tell he's mad because he keeps biting at things!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica storms over to Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?! Why would you bring Lyle here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why wouldn't I? Everyone loves Lyle!
As soon as Ryan says that, Lyle snaps at him, biting the side of his head!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ow! Ow ow ow!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You have got to be kidding me...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Them's the breaks, little lady.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Game. Set. `Checkmate.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Game. Set. [color=#e23b3b][i]Checkmate.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So not fair!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Attention! Everyone has ten minutes to vacate the premises, go home, and sit in melancholy silence, contemplating the futility of your lives!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aw... I hate doing that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're the worst, Officer Monte!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just doing my job!
Erik and Monte walk away from the park as the students turn and scatter...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Mmmm... Smell that? That's the smell of a bunch of quiet, unhappy people on New Year's Eve!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah... About that...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Got something to say, Shortstop?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... Not to question my Superior Officer... But what we're doing here doesn't really seem right...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean, I'm all about Protecting and Serving, but none of these parties are really bothering anyone...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe we should just let them be.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now listen here, little man, because I'm only going to say this once.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Parties might seem like good times where no one gets hurt. They might `seem` like totally harmless get-togethers where everyone's laughing and having fun...
nodes.text_bbcode: Parties might seem like good times where no one gets hurt. They might [color=#e23b3b][i]seem[/i][/color] like totally harmless get-togethers where everyone's laughing and having fun...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But they're not! Every party `always` goes wrong! And someone gets laughed at! And someone gets teased! And someone gets called a little shrimp with a weirdo mustache!
nodes.text_bbcode: But they're not! Every party [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] goes wrong! And someone gets laughed at! And someone gets teased! And someone gets called a little shrimp with a weirdo mustache!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did... Did something happen to you at a party?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No! Shut up! Now let's go put the shin in shindig!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay...
And so Monte and Erik go around town...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I've seen a lot of New Year's debauchery, but I'm not sure I've ever seen anything so sick and depraved...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We're just sitting around watching movies and eating popcorn!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yeah? What do you call this weapon of mass destruction?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's a welding torch!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's evidence now, punk! Now get out!
And after that, in the MAN frat...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Show's over, folks! Time to get back to the disgusting dens of trash you call homes!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Dude, are you gonna bust every party we throw?!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: This is the worst college ever!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You'll thank me when you're older, son. Now get moving!
And soon enough, they approach a familiar house...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Last house on my list. This one was a real squeaker... Barely registered on the decibel scale...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But no one gets by Officer Monte Carlos Monte!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey... Wait a minute... I know where we are...
But before Erik can stop him, Monte kicks open the door...
And storms into Brendan's den!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Nobody move! This party is officially busted!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! Please don't arrest me, sir!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This can't be happening! I've already got priors!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...What do you have priors for?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sophomore year was rough times, man.
Suddenly, Ashley stands up and points...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: `Erik?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Erik?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Hi guys.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you doing with him? Did you lead him here?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, I didn't lead him here, I swear! I think he has super-hearing!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: More like a super sense of justice. Parties over, Pointdexters. Get on home.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, sir, I really don't think you need to break this party up. We're not doing anything wrong...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh yeah? There's noise level for one...
Monte turns to the side of the room where the table is set up for `Ogres and Elves.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Monte turns to the side of the room where the table is set up for [b]Ogres and Elves.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Over here, we've clearly got some kind of devil-summoning ritual...
He turns to the far side of the room, where Taylor is covering her face in embarrassment...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And I can't even begin to fathom why you'd have a pretty cheerleader-type here short of some sort of elaborate kidnapping scenario...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just a tip, kids... You'll never get the ransom. Her parents don't love her nearly enough.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now, if you could all just be on your way...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I said no. This isn't right. These are my friends, and they're just having fun.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I agreed to be a Junior Detective because I thought it was the right thing to do... Because I believed in truth and justice...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But if this is justice... Then I quit!
Erik rips the badge off his chest and hurls it at Monte. Slowly, Monte kneels down and picks it off the floor.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: ...This is a Space 'Splosions Convention Attendee Badge.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes it is. Yes. It. `Is.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes it is. Yes. It. [color=#e23b3b][i]Is.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Whoa... Was Erik just... Kind of awesome?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I know!
Officer Monte sighs deeply...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Look, son, I appreciate that it's not always easy to do the right thing... But the law's the law!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then why are you the only officer working tonight?! I thought maybe you were just dedicated, and then I thought maybe you were the only officer in the world...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But now I think you might just be crazy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So here's what's gonna happen, `Jefe`. My friends and I are going over to this table where we're gonna sit down and play `Ogres and Elves.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So here's what's gonna happen, [color=#e23b3b][i]Jefe[/i][/color]. My friends and I are going over to this table where we're gonna sit down and play [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You can either forcefully drag us out of here and make a huge scene...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or you can sit down and join us!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: J... Join you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure, why not? It doesn't seem like you're doing anything else!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, it'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We're doing the Dragons with Flagons expansion! It's, uh... It's gonna get pretty real.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's just, I... I don't really want to get made fun of...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No one's gonna make fun of you!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, we're nerds! We're the guys who `get` made fun of!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we're nerds! We're the guys who [color=#e23b3b][i]get[/i][/color] made fun of!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tell me about it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You in... Sir?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Okay! But just for a little while!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yay! This is weird, but yay!
Everyone settles down at the table. Monte awkwardly takes a seat...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So, the first thing you need to do is create a character...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I will be Osmund Bricklebeard, Vanguard of the Hyberian Wastes, Harbinger of the Seventh Apocalypse, and Wielder of the Obsidian Moustache of Oblivion!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Whoa! Have you played this before?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Not at all. I'm just very, `very` manly.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not at all. I'm just very, [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] manly.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now let's kill some dragons and take their flagons!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!
Wow! Looks like Erik managed to bring a little holiday cheer to Officer Monte! Who would've thought?
We hope you enjoyed this `exclusive` piece of promotional content! Keep drinking Dr. Pepper, and see the other special stories!
nodes.text_bbcode: We hope you enjoyed this [b]exclusive[/b] piece of promotional content! Keep drinking Dr. Pepper, and see the other special stories!
